# GGM Technologies

> Premier Digital Marketing, Technical SEO, PPC Advertising, and Modern Web Development Agency based in New Delhi, India.

GGM Technologies partners with startups, high-growth SMEs, and enterprise brands to build revenue-attributable search rankings, high-converting digital ad funnels, custom Next.js web applications, and scalable eCommerce platforms.

## Core Services

- [Website Development](https://ggmtechnologies.com/services/website-development): Custom Next.js, React, and full-stack web applications engineered for sub-second Core Web Vitals, enterprise security, and conversion rate optimization.
- [SEO (Search Engine Optimization)](https://ggmtechnologies.com/services/seo): Full-funnel search engine optimization including technical audits, semantic entity optimization, topical authority clustering, and white-hat link acquisition.
- [E-Commerce Website Development](https://ggmtechnologies.com/services/e-commerce): Custom online storefronts on Shopify, WooCommerce, and headless commerce architectures with payment gateway and logistics integrations.
- [Lead Generation](https://ggmtechnologies.com/services/lead-generation): High-intent B2B and B2C lead generation systems combining performance advertising, localized landing pages, and automated CRM routing.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://ggmtechnologies.com/services/social-media-marketing): Targeted performance campaigns across Meta (Facebook, Instagram), LinkedIn, and YouTube focused on verified customer acquisition.
- [Shopify Development](https://ggmtechnologies.com/services/shopify-development): High-converting custom Shopify and Shopify Plus themes, app integrations, and conversion checkout optimizations.
- [WordPress Development](https://ggmtechnologies.com/services/wordpress-development): Fast, secure, and custom-built WordPress architectures with zero bloat and streamlined CMS editing.
- [Google AdSense Services](https://ggmtechnologies.com/services/google-adsense): High-yield ad placement strategy, viewability optimization, and publisher compliance.
- [Mobile App Development](https://ggmtechnologies.com/services/mobile-app-development): Native and cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android built on React Native and Flutter.

## SEO Authority & Backlink Products

- [Editorial Guest Posting](https://ggmtechnologies.com/shop/guest-posting): 100% manual editorial outreach on verified niche publications with Domain Authority 50+ and 10k+ organic traffic.
- [High DA Backlinks Package](https://ggmtechnologies.com/shop/high-da-backlink): Tiered authority backlinks from established digital portals to accelerate competitive keyword rankings.
- [Web 2.0 Authority Network](https://ggmtechnologies.com/shop/web-2-0-backlink): Structured web 2.0 foundation tier backlinks for balanced anchor distribution.
